# ponte_webhook (Resource)

An outbound webhook subscription: platform events (authz decisions, receipt.issued, alerts, …) delivered to a URL, HMAC-signed. Format ponte (the envelope) or udm (Google SecOps).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ponte_webhook" "siem" {
  name         = "SIEM"
  url          = "https://siem.example.com/hooks/ponte"
  event_types  = ["governance.alert", "authz.decision", "receipt.issued"]
  min_severity = "high" # security findings: critical and high
}

# The secret Ponte signs deliveries with, for the receiving side.
output "siem_signing_secret" {
  value     = ponte_webhook.siem.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (Set of String) Event types, or ["*"] for all. GET /api/v1/webhooks/event-types lists them. Order does not matter.
- `name` (String)
- `url` (String) https URL; private targets are refused in production.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `format` (String) ponte or udm.
- `format_config` (String) JSON overrides for the udm mapping (event_type_map, product_name, vendor_name, default_event_type). Removing it clears the overrides.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers sent on every delivery (an Authorization header, for example). Not read back from the api.
- `min_severity` (String) Lowest level of security finding (governance.alert) delivered: critical, high or medium. Other event types are not filtered. Low findings are never sent.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) The HMAC secret Ponte signs deliveries with (X-Ponte-Signature). Returned once on create.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The signing secret is shown once at creation and headers are never returned: neither is imported.
terraform import ponte_webhook.siem 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
